evaluation.summary: N1 remains a narrow authenticated acquisition boundary. N2b extends only the fixed GET surface with current New-tutorial form acquisition using the canonical zero-locator route; credentials/cookies remain session-private, student email fields are stripped at acquisition, and no generic request or GEL tutorial mutation API exists. Login remains the only POST authority.

authentication.cookie_ownership: Cookies are private to the Rust GEL session client and are never returned to parsers, repositories, UI models, logs or diagnostics.
authentication.error_redaction_rule: Authentication errors must not include the supplied password, cookie values, serialized login form body or full response body.

read_surface.description: DataTables-paginated school-wide student search with privacy rule stripping email fields

privacy.rule: Student email-like fields are removed recursively before student roster/profile JSON leaves the session component.

network_authority.rule: N1/N2b grant fixed read acquisition only. The New-form zero-locator GET is source acquisition, not create authority. No create, revise, delete or arbitrary transport method is exposed.

failure_semantics.malformed_tutorial_identity_json: fail closed; do not invent id or timestamp
failure_semantics.unexpected_login_page: fail authentication without exposing response body

required_evidence: Rust login succeeds against api2 and learn2
tutorial-list identity timestamp agrees with a parsed summary entry
matching print and historical edit pages can be fetched by GET
historical edit page passes C1 validation
probe emits metadata/status only and does not print tutorial HTML or credentials
